en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a formal baroque-style garden leading toward a city center. Symmetrical paths, fountains, and manicured flowerbeds stretch from the foreground toward a large statue in the middle distance, beyond which stand arcaded buildings and several prominent towers. The image has an old photographic style typical of early 20th‑century postcards. The printed words 'Karlsruhe' and 'Totalansicht' appear at the top.
